title: Card game dev
author: Low_Pie8824
selftext:
I've been working on my game for about a month now, and... shit, I think it's actually starting to get addictive 😅

It's called Project Ascension, a dark fantasy card game with RPG elements that I'm building in Unreal Engine.

I've spent the last few weeks constantly changing mechanics, testing things, throwing stuff away and rebuilding it... and today I had one of those moments where I opened the game just to test something for 5 minutes and ended up actually playing it.

That's probably the first time I've thought:

"Wait... this is starting to feel like an actual game."

There's still a ridiculous amount of work to do, obviously, but seeing all the systems slowly come together and, more importantly, actually starting to have fun playing my own game feels pretty damn good.

This is what it looks like after roughly one month of development.

Would love to hear what you guys think — especially about the gameplay/UI and what catches your attention first.

P.S. I'm also slowly adding card art using Midjourney, and I created my own card-making tool called Card Forge to help me design and build the cards more easily.

comments.body: Mate, it looks awesome. May I ask what's your pipeline of work? Are you using claude code or cursor or something else for the AI? Also, the UI are assets you found or created with an 3D API like meshy? Again, awesome work.

replies.author: Low_Pie8824
replies.body:
Uso codexAstra conectándose directamente a unreal engine, le doy indicaciones de que busque en fab asets gratuitos y los implemente.

También he creado una herramienta aparte para poder crear las cartas por ejemplo:


Quiero 60 cartas de mago, la herramienta crea 60 cartas sin arte pero respeta siempre el marcó, que es lo que distingue una carta por ejemplo de clerigo a una carta de mago sabes? Luego implemente la mecánica del dado d20 como diferenciador de otros juegos de cartas donde si sacas un 1 es una pifia y la carta no declara su ataque si no que recibes 1 de daño, si sacas un 20, las cartas tienen un efecto adicional.

Pero básicamente es todo codex y unreal. 😋
